subject.title: [Feature]: Human-readable ClickClack discussion channel names (session titles, not hashes)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a generic operator-scoped session-change event for plugins to support ClickClack discussion-name reconciliation, alongside ClickClack-local title-based naming?
rationale: The request is more than a display fix: it proposes a durable plugin gateway API and changes when session titles are generated, so maintainers must choose the intended long-term boundary and operator behavior.

options.title: Approve the scoped owner-boundary design
options.body: Let ClickClack own naming and reconciliation, and add a generic documented gateway event only after confirming no existing plugin-facing event supports this use case.

options.title: Keep the change ClickClack-local
options.body: Improve title-derived labels and bounded reconciliation without adding a new gateway facade event, accepting slower convergence where necessary.

options.title: Defer the API direction
options.body: Keep the current behavior until maintainers define a broader session-event contract for plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped owner-boundary design
recommendation.body: Let ClickClack own naming and reconciliation, and add a generic documented gateway event only after confirming no existing plugin-facing event supports this use case.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue author supplied the concrete proposal and can clarify the intended ClickClack-side contract; repository history was unavailable for a stronger routing candidate.
